import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms, models
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from PIL import Image
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
torch.manual_seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = Path("./input")
SUBMISSION_DIR = Path("./submission")
SUBMISSION_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_DIR / "train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_DIR / "test.csv")

# Image directory
image_dir = INPUT_DIR / "images"


# Convert image IDs to absolute paths
def get_image_path(image_id):
    return image_dir / f"{image_id}.jpg"


# Create datasets
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.transform = transform
        self.image_dir = image_dir

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        image_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["image_id"]
        image_path = self.image_dir / f"{image_id}.jpg"
        image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)
        labels = {
            col: int(self.df.iloc[idx][col])
            for col in ["healthy", "multiple_diseases", "rust", "scab"]
        }
        labels_tensor = torch.tensor(
            [labels[col] for col in labels], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        return image, labels_tensor


# Data transformations - training augmentations
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(30),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

# Validation transform - for hold-out validation
val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

# Test-time augmentation transforms for inference
tta_transforms = [
    # Original (no augmentation)
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
    # Horizontal flip
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
            transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
    # 90 degree rotation
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
            transforms.RandomRotation(90),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
    # Color jitter
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
            transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
    # Combined flips and rotations
    transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
            transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
            transforms.RandomRotation(180),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    ),
]

# Hold-out validation split (30%) - this will be used for metric estimation only
train_indices = np.random.choice(len(train_df), int(len(train_df) * 0.7), replace=False)
val_indices = np.array([i for i in range(len(train_df)) if i not in train_indices])

train_df_split = train_df.iloc[train_indices].reset_index(drop=True)
val_df_split = train_df.iloc[val_indices].reset_index(drop=True)

# Create data loaders
train_dataset = LeafDataset(train_df_split, train_transform)
val_dataset = LeafDataset(val_df_split, val_transform)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=32,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=4,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=32,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=4,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)

# Model - pretrained ResNet18 with pretrained weights
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT)
num_classes = 4
model.fc = nn.Linear(model.fc.in_features, num_classes)
model.to(device)

# Training configuration
criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=15)

# Training
num_epochs = 15
best_val_auc = 0
patience = 5
patience_counter = 0
early_stop = False

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    # Training phase
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for images, labels in train_loader:
        images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(images)
        loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()

    scheduler.step()

    # Validation phase
    model.eval()
    val_outputs = []
    val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, labels in val_loader:
            images = images.to(device)
            outputs = model(images)
            val_outputs.append(outputs.cpu())
            val_labels.append(labels.cpu())

    val_outputs = torch.cat(val_outputs, dim=0).sigmoid()
    val_labels = torch.cat(val_labels, dim=0)

    # Calculate column-wise ROC AUC
    val_aucs = []
    for i in range(num_classes):
        y_true = val_labels[:, i].numpy()
        y_pred = val_outputs[:, i].numpy()
        if np.sum(y_true == 1) > 0 and np.sum(y_true == 0) > 0:
            auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_pred)
            val_aucs.append(auc)
        else:
            val_aucs.append(0.5)

    val_auc = np.mean(val_aucs)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs}, Train Loss: {train_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}, Val AUC: {val_auc:.4f}"
    )

    if val_auc > best_val_auc:
        best_val_auc = val_auc
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth")
        patience_counter = 0
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            early_stop = True
            break

# Load best model
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pth", map_location=device))
model.eval()

# Test-Time Augmentation for test predictions
print("\nApplying Test-Time Augmentation for test predictions...")
test_image_ids = test_df["image_id"].tolist()
all_predictions = {col: [] for col in ["healthy", "multiple_diseases", "rust", "scab"]}

for tta_transform in tta_transforms:
    for image_id in test_image_ids:
        image_path = get_image_path(image_id)
        image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
        image_tensor = tta_transform(image).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            output = model(image_tensor).sigmoid()

        # Extract predictions for each class
        for i, col in enumerate(["healthy", "multiple_diseases", "rust", "scab"]):
            all_predictions[col].append(output[0, i].item())

# Average predictions across all TTA variants
for col in all_predictions:
    all_predictions[col] = np.array(all_predictions[col])
    all_predictions[col] = np.mean(all_predictions[col], axis=0)

# Create submission DataFrame - match sample_submission format exactly
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "image_id": test_image_ids,
        "healthy": all_predictions["healthy"],
        "multiple_diseases": all_predictions["multiple_diseases"],
        "rust": all_predictions["rust"],
        "scab": all_predictions["scab"],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_DIR / "submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_DIR / 'submission.csv'}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission_df.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Submission sample:\n{submission_df.head()}")

# Calculate validation AUC for reference (same as training metric)
model.eval()
val_outputs = []
val_labels = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for images, labels in val_loader:
        images = images.to(device)
        outputs = model(images)
        val_outputs.append(outputs.cpu())
        val_labels.append(labels.cpu())
val_outputs = torch.cat(val_outputs, dim=0).sigmoid()
val_labels = torch.cat(val_labels, dim=0)

val_aucs = []
for i in range(num_classes):
    y_true = val_labels[:, i].numpy()
    y_pred = val_outputs[:, i].numpy()
    if np.sum(y_true == 1) > 0 and np.sum(y_true == 0) > 0:
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_pred)
        val_aucs.append(auc)
    else:
        val_aucs.append(0.5)
final_val_auc = np.mean(val_aucs)

print(f"\n=== Model Training Complete ===")
print(f"Final Validation AUC (mean-column-wise-ROC-AUC): {final_val_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Best Validation AUC saved during training: {best_val_auc:.4f}")
print("Submission file ready for evaluation at submission/submission.csv")
